content: ffmpeg-static npm package returns the path of a statically linked FFmpeg binary via require('ffmpeg-static') or import ffmpegPath from 'ffmpeg-static'. ESM: 'import ffmpegPath from "ffmpeg-static"'. Returns string path like '/node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg'. Works on Linux (Railway), macOS, Windows. No postinstall network calls. v5.3.0 is current. Use path with child_process.spawn(ffmpegPath, [...args]).
